def recite(start_verse, end_verse):
    animals = [
        "fly",
        "spider",
        "bird",
        "cat",
        "dog",
        "goat",
        "cow",
        "horse",
    ]

    remarks = [
        "",  # fly
        "It wriggled and jiggled and tickled inside her.",
        "How absurd to swallow a bird!",
        "Imagine that, to swallow a cat!",
        "What a hog, to swallow a dog!",
        "Just opened her throat and swallowed a goat!",
        "I don't know how she swallowed a cow!",
        "She's dead, of course!",
    ]

    spider_extra = " that wriggled and jiggled and tickled inside her."

    output_lines = []
    for idx in range(start_verse - 1, end_verse):
        animal = animals[idx]
        # Opening line
        output_lines.append(f"I know an old lady who swallowed a {animal}.")

        # Remark line if present
        remark = remarks[idx]
        if remark:
            output_lines.append(remark)

        # Horse: special case, ends song for that verse
        if animal == "horse":
            # remark already appended ("She's dead, of course!")
            # add blank line between verses if not the last requested verse
            if idx != end_verse - 1:
                output_lines.append("")
            continue

        # Fly: only the final repeated line after opening (and no cumulative)
        if animal == "fly":
            output_lines.append("I don't know why she swallowed the fly. Perhaps she'll die.")
            if idx != end_verse - 1:
                output_lines.append("")
            continue

        # Cumulative chain for other animals
        for j in range(idx, 0, -1):
            predator = animals[j]
            prey = animals[j - 1]
            line = f"She swallowed the {predator} to catch the {prey}"
            if prey == "spider":
                line += spider_extra
            line += "."
            output_lines.append(line)

        # Final repeated fly line
        output_lines.append("I don't know why she swallowed the fly. Perhaps she'll die.")

        # blank line between verses except after last
        if idx != end_verse - 1:
            output_lines.append("")

    return output_lines
